KPI_1.name: New Customer Opportunity ACV
KPI_1.description: Total Annual Contract Value for new customer opportunities, a key revenue metric for business growth.

KPI_2.name: Existing Customer Expansion ACV
KPI_2.description: Total Annual Contract Value for existing customer expansion opportunities, measuring upsell and cross-sell success.

KPI_3.name: Booking ACV Target Achievement
KPI_3.description: Target booking Annual Contract Value used for performance measurement and goal tracking.

KPI_4.name: S1 Pipeline ACV for New Customers
KPI_4.description: Annual Contract Value of opportunities in S1 stage for new customers, indicating early-stage pipeline health.

KPI_5.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count
KPI_5.description: Number of new opportunities created in the S1 defining stage, measuring sales pipeline generation.

KPI_6.name: S1+ Pipeline Coverage
KPI_6.description: Total pipeline Annual Contract Value for S1 and above stages, used for pipeline coverage analysis.

KPI_7.name: S0 Pipeline ACV for New Customers
KPI_7.description: Annual Contract Value of opportunities in S0 qualifying stage for new customers, measuring early pipeline value.

KPI_8.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count
KPI_8.description: Number of new opportunities created in the S0 qualifying stage, indicating top-of-funnel activity.

KPI_9.name: S3 Pipeline ACV for New Customers
KPI_9.description: Annual Contract Value of opportunities in S3 stage for new customers, representing qualified late-stage pipeline.

KPI_10.name: S3 Opportunities Created Count
KPI_10.description: Number of new opportunities created in the S3 stage, measuring progression to advanced sales stages.

attributes: Opportunity Type, Booking Target Geo (by BT RegSeg), Opportunity Source MQL Classification, Opportunity Stage, Creation Target Geo
goal: Monitor and optimize sales pipeline performance across all stages to drive revenue growth and achieve quarterly booking targets.
user_context: CMO and senior marketing executives use this dashboard during quarterly business reviews and monthly pipeline meetings to comprehensively assess marketing and sales performance by first examining the Health of Business tab to review quarterly booking targets versus achievements across regions and segments, then analyzing the Stage Age & Conversions tab to understand funnel progression from M1 through S3 stages and identify conversion bottlenecks, followed by evaluating the Lead Source Analysis tab to determine which marketing channels and campaigns are generating the highest quality MQLs and pipeline, next reviewing the Trials tab to assess free trial conversion rates and user activation metrics, then examining the Pipeline Coverage tab to ensure adequate pipeline coverage for current and future quarters by geography and segment, and finally using the Creation to Targets tab to track progress against creation targets for each stage while identifying areas requiring immediate attention or resource reallocation.
